text:
eve: Noticed medium-length p99 regressions after mini-window fastpath rollout. Mixed traffic 70/30 short/medium.

liam: Same. avg latency improved but medium p99 up ~55ms. Any KV miss correlation?

eve: Yes, kv_miss_rate for medium class doubled during spikes. Also many medium requests were repeatedly deferred.

sam: Root causes: (1) coalesce windows closing too quickly due to shorts, (2) KV cache eviction thrash when mediums finally run.

liam: Brainstorm fixes: A) length-aware reservations in the continuous batcher, B) dedicated micro-lane for >=X tokens, C) increase mini-window but that hurts short tail.

eve: Preference for hybrid: keep primary continuous path + tiny pre-admit reservation for estimated >=140 tokens so we avoid premature closes for that tenant.

sam: Key constraints: must be cheap (no expensive forecasting), reversible, and not blow up telemetry costs.

liam: Implementation sketch: pre_admit check that atomically reserves soft tokens from per-tenant sliding budget. Pseudocode: 
```
if est_tokens >= 140 and coalesce_rounds < 2 and tenant_budget >= est_tokens+headroom:
  tenant_budget -= est_tokens+headroom
  mark_reserved(tenant, slot_id)
else:
  join_opportunistic_pool()
```

eve: Add reclaim: if reserved slot unused in 20ms -> release and increment reservation_release metric. Cap headroom to 32 tokens initially.

sam: Metrics to add: reserved_slots, reservation_release_rate, kv_evictions_by_length, forced_micro_lane_rate, p99_per_length.

ops-bot: Canary checklist created: batcher/pre-admit -> canary-pool-1 (owner: infra).

liam: Rollout plan: 5 tenants for 48h, gate on kv_eviction down and medium p99 down. If reservation_miss_rate > 5% revert.

eve: Edge-case: bursts of shorts could still crowd GPU and delay reserved slot consumption. Mitigate by making coalescer check reservation hints before finalizing a window. Minimal api: reserve_hint(tenant, slot_id) so coalescer can try to include reserved requests early.

sam: Also need tracing: include reservation_id and tenant_budget_delta in spans to correlate regressions.

liam: Ops rollback: single flag to disable pre-admit or set medium_threshold=9999. Keep this simple.

eve: Action items: Eve will prototype pre-admit in bench harness, Liam add metrics/tracing, Sam prepare canary runbook and kill-switch. We'll reconvene after 48h of data.

ops-bot: Runbook created and linked.
